translations.web: He said, “You shall take these seven ewe lambs from my hand, that it may be a witness to me, that I have dug this well.”
translations.bsb: He replied, “You are to accept the seven ewe lambs from my hand as my witness that I dug this well.”
translations.kjv: And he said, For these seven ewe lambs shalt thou take of my hand, that they may be a witness unto me, that I have digged this well.
translations.asv: And he said, These seven ewe lambs shalt thou take of my hand, that it may be a witness unto me, that I have digged this well.
